subject: Pipeline hygiene: stage updates + contingency playbook (Q4 close)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: stage updates + contingency playbook (Q4 close)

Team —

As we push toward quarter close I need a rapid sweep of the books to make the forecast usable for finance next week. Action items below — please treat this as a 48-hour priority:

1) Stage updates in CRM: mark any opportunity where the legal/procurement milestone is not complete as "Commit: UNCERTAIN". If procurement has an LOI or signed contract, mark as "Commit: CONFIRMED" and attach the latest doc.

2) Risk matrix: open the attached Q4_account_risk_matrix.xlsx and add/update each account row with one of {RED, YELLOW, GREEN} and a 1-line justification. Red = >50% chance to slip out of quarter without active remediation.

3) Owners & playbooks: Assign a single remediation owner for every RED/YELLOW deal and add a 2–3 action-step save plan (e.g., expedite PO, schedule exec procurement call, offer interim credit).

4) Finance classification: call out anything that should be treated as a soft-push (move to next quarter) vs a hard commit. Karthik — finance will need your list to finalize the revenue schedule.

Halcyon Health is one account I've flagged as at-risk. Marcus, please confirm the status below and attach the MAP.

Attachments: Q4_account_risk_matrix.xlsx

Goal: consolidated rollup by EOD Monday so I can hand to Finance Tuesday morning.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
